# Md. Tariqul Islam — Full-Stack Web Developer

> Full-stack web developer from Savar, Dhaka, Bangladesh specializing in Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Python with AI integration.

## About

Md. Tariqul Islam is a full-stack web developer with 2+ years of experience building modern web applications. B.Sc. in CSE from Gono Bishwabidyalay (2023-2027). Based in Savar, Dhaka, Bangladesh.

## Core Expertise

- **Frontend**: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, Three.js
- **Backend**: Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, REST APIs, JWT Auth
- **AI/ML**: OpenAI, Gemini, LangChain, RAG, Prompt Engineering
- **Python**: FastAPI, Django, pandas, NumPy, Selenium
- **DevOps**: Vercel, Cloudflare, Git, CI/CD
